command.name: Silent Shade
verbatim: Rounds 1, 4, 6, 9: 40% chance to increase the Tactical Damage Received of 1 Enemy in the same lane by +15% for 2 round(s).
Rounds 1, 4, 6, 9: Deal Tactical Damage to 2 Enemies within adjacency (Damage Rate: +75%).

vanguard.name: Sentinel's Wit
vanguard.verbatim: At Level 16+ and deployed in the Vanguard, increase Tactical Damage Dealt by +16%. Increase Instinct and Initiative by +20 of the Ally deployed in the Left Flank.

habits.name: Battle Mastery
habits.verbatim: Start of Combat: Reduce the Strength and Instinct (enhanced by Intelligence) of 3 enemies by -5% until the end of combat.

habits.name: Keen Instinct
habits.verbatim: Start of Combat: Increase your Intelligence and Instinct by +16% until the end of combat.

habits.name: Fearsome Reach
habits.verbatim: Odd-numbered Rounds: 30% chance to reduce the Instinct (enhanced by Intelligence) by -15% and afflict Panic (Damage Rate: +20%) on 3 Enemies in any lane for 2 round(s).

habits.name: Steel Shroud
habits.verbatim: Start of Combat: Reduce Physical Damage Received (excluding Basic Attacks) and Tactical Damage Received by -3% of 2 other Allies in any lane until the end of combat.

habits.name: Cloak of Terror
habits.verbatim: Odd-numbered Rounds: 10% chance to afflict Overwhelm on 2 Enemies within adjacency for 2 round(s). This chance is doubled (20%) if the target is afflicted with Vulnerable.
